candidates.invariant: Changing the public helper to require MemberId must not break existing valid callers unless every caller is migrated.
candidates.counterexample: A caller holding a valid canonical ID as a plain string can no longer pass it to memberCacheKey because the brand is compile-time-only.
candidates.evidenceNeeded: Search immediate memberCacheKey call sites and verify the existing typecheck/build for unbranded string arguments.

clear.reason: No authorization decision changes; the cache key still includes a length-delimited tenant ID.
Runtime trimming, uppercasing, and MEM-###### validation are unchanged; the new brand does not alter normalized values.

escalations.reason: Validate whether existing memberCacheKey callers pass plain strings; the local command runner could not read the packet or search the repository.
